svg.title: Flow cytometry
svg.desc: Flow-cytometry dot-density plot with logarithmic-looking axes, quadrant gates, clusters, and percentages. Biological basis: Flow plots display single-event fluorescence measurements; gates partition phenotypic populations and are interpreted with controls.
